title: Probiotics vs placebo/no probiotic for prevention of antibiotic-associated diarrhoea
declared_method: Random-effects inverse-variance on the log ratio (log RR/OR/HR/IRR as configured for the outcome); Paule-Mandel tau^2; HKSJ 95% CI on t_{k-1} (variance floor max(1,Q/(k-1))); prediction interval mu +/- t_{k-1}*sqrt(tau2+se^2). Validated vs metafor 5.0.1.
served_method: Random-effects inverse-variance on the log ratio (log RR/OR/HR/IRR as configured for the outcome); Paule-Mandel tau^2; HKSJ 95% CI on t_{k-1} (variance floor max(1,Q/(k-1))); prediction interval mu +/- t_{k-1}*sqrt(tau2+se^2). Validated vs metafor 5.0.1.

comparator.name: Probiotics for the prevention of antibiotic-associated diarrhoea: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
